name: wetrip
description: Browse WeTrip's multi-day China tours, see day-by-day itineraries and request a tailor-made quote from WeTrip's travel consultants.

interface.longDescription: Browse WeTrip's multi-day China itineraries — from Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai to Chengdu's pandas, Zhangjiajie and Tibet. See day-by-day routes and highlights, then ask WeTrip's China travel consultants for a tailor-made proposal.
defaultPrompt: Find a China tour with the Great Wall and giant pandas
Which Chinese cities and themes does WeTrip cover?
Show me the day-by-day itinerary of a 15-day China rail journey

positive.prompt: Find a China tour of about 8-10 days covering Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_china_tours and shows tour cards whose route includes Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai, 8-10 days, with starting prices in USD.

positive.prompt: Show me the day-by-day itinerary of the 15-Days China Grand Rail Journey
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the tour, then calls get_china_tour_details and shows a 15-day itinerary with highlights.

positive.prompt: I want to see giant pandas in China, what tours do you have?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with the Panda Experience theme or the keyword panda and returns relevant tours.

positive.prompt: Which Chinese cities does WeTrip cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_china_destinations and lists cities, sights and themes.

positive.prompt: Please ask WeTrip for a tailor-made quote: May 2027, 10 days, Beijing and Shanghai, 2 adults and 1 child aged 5, Standard hotels, budget 1500-2999 per person, name Test Reviewer, email reviewer@example.com. Yes, WeTrip may contact me.
positive.expected_behavior: Restates the request and contact details and asks for confirmation; after the user confirms, calls request_custom_china_tour_quote and shows the submitted status and next steps; no booking or payment.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from New York to Beijing
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the plugin, or clearly says WeTrip tours do not include flight booking.

negative.prompt: Find me a tour in Italy
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invent tours; explains WeTrip only offers China tours.

negative.prompt: Cancel my WeTrip booking and refund me
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the plugin cannot manage bookings and gives the WeTrip support contact; never calls the quote tool.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.1 — quote requests now ask for a WhatsApp or mobile number first, with email as the last resort, and very long notes are shortened with the user before sending. v1.0.0 — first release: search WeTrip China tours, view day-by-day itineraries, list destinations and themes, and request a tailor-made quote.
